content.comment_body: Hello, When programming any [product_name] PLC and adding an expansion module, such as [product_name] (example: [article_no]), how are the inputs defined in the software? If the base module has 8 inputs labeled I1 to I8, does the first input of the expansion module become I9, or is it labeled differently? Do we need to configure the software for the new module or is it detected automatically? Thanks, [user_name]

That's correct. On the expansion unit, the first digital input is I9, the next is I10, and this continues sequentially. Similarly, outputs are numbered so that DO5 follows the outputs on the base [product_name]. When programming in the software, be sure to use the correct numbering; I9 will be the first input on the expansion module.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are clarifying how [product_name] expansion modules connect to the base unit, particularly regarding input and output numbering. Responses confirm that expansion module inputs and outputs are automatically numbered after those of the base module. A key point of interest is whether the software configuration for new modules is automatic or requires manual action.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the programming software will integrate expansion module inputs and outputs in a clear, logical order, ideally without needing manual configuration.
